decisions.reason: Redesigning the interactive-field setup does not change the required style catalog or its template-set coverage.
The field-architecture redesign neither changes the required default language nor resolves the existing Danish-versus-English conflict.
A more robust field architecture does not establish a new visual-cue design or resolve whether editable fields should appear grey.
The source decision concerns document fields and does not alter bullet appearance, scaling, alignment, or level-9 color.
The architectural redesign does not change the expected behavior that Title-field formatting be preserved during interaction.
The source does not modify the required click-triggered placeholder-clearing behavior.
The redesign of interactive fields does not change legacy-content paste behavior or resolve the existing paste-workflow ambiguity.
The source decision does not affect containment of pasted tables or right-hand columns within page margins.
The field-setup redesign does not change the requirement for reliable manual line breaks after pasting.
The source does not change the NXQ style prefix, its application condition, or the language of style names.
Interactive-field architecture is independent of Tab-driven list hierarchy and alignment behavior.
The redesign remains subject to the existing Word for Windows reliability constraint but does not modify that constraint.
